title: Join the dkNET Webinar Friday on the Mammalian Adipose Tissue Knowledge Portal (MATKP, matkp.org)!
bodyHtml:
? Curious about the Mammalian Adipose Tissue Knowledge Portal (MATKP, matkp.org)?

‼️Join #dkNET webinar featuring Julie Jurgens, PhD, who will share the latest updates, datasets, and interactive features.

? The top 3 key questions that the MATKP can answer:

1. How do specific genes influence adipose tissue biology and related metabolic phenotypes?

2. Which adipose tissue signatures, pathways, and gene programs are associated with metabolic disease phenotypes?

3. How do cell type-specific expression patterns contribute to disease mechanisms?

? Friday, February 27th, 2026 | 2-3 PM ET
? Dial-in Information: https://uchealth.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_vSra3PQzQHCPMTeFJnul0w
